content_sections.heading: KAU Gym Instructor Vacancy Details (Post-wise)
content_sections.text: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Gym Instructor post under the Directorate of Students Welfare, Vellanikkara.

content_sections.heading: KAU Gym Instructor Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Valid and updated CPR / AED First Aid Certificate.

rows.qualification_required: Degree in Exercise Science / Exercise Physiology from a UGC-recognized institution with at least 2 years of working experience in any recognized gym; OR Fitness Trainer Course Certificate / Gym Trainer Course Certificate / Fitness Management Course Certificate from a nationally recognized institution with at least 2 years of working experience in any recognized gym; OR Candidates who have completed B.P.E / B.P.Ed / B.P.E.S Diploma and obtained a Diploma/Certificate in Gym/Fitness Instructor from UGC-recognized Central/State Government institutions along with at least 2 years of working experience in any recognized gym.
